# functions 
```{r}
Plot_overview <- function(Trialless, orderby_Behv = "A2L", by_time = F, theme_smo = theme_minimal()) {
  # either arrange the data by decreasing firing rate after 0 or by
  if (by_time == F) {
    ord <- Trialless %>%
      filter(between(rel_time, 0, 0.1)) %>%
      group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
      filter(Behv == orderby_Behv) %>%
      group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
      summarise(ord = mean(Zscore)) %>%
      arrange(ord) %>%
      mutate(cluster_id2 = as.factor(cluster_id2)) %>%
      pull(cluster_id2)
  }
  if (by_time == T) {
    ord <- Trialless %>%
      group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
      filter(between(rel_time, -1, 1)) %>%
      filter(Behv == orderby_Behv) %>%
      group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
      slice_max(Zscore, n = 1, with_ties = F) %>%
      summarise(ord = rel_time) %>%
      arrange(ord) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      mutate(cluster_id2 = as.factor(cluster_id2)) %>%
      pull(cluster_id2)
  }





  # z score and filter
  g1 <- Trialless %>%
    filter(between(rel_time, -1, 1)) %>%
    select(Behv, cluster_id2, Zscore, rel_time)



  # apply order
  g1$cluster_id2 <- factor(g1$cluster_id2, levels = ord)





  # heatmap
  map <- g1 %>%
    mutate(Zscore = ifelse(Zscore > 8, 8, Zscore)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(rel_time, cluster_id2, fill = Zscore)) +
    rasterise(geom_tile(), dpi = 600) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, col = "grey", linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_wrap(~Behv, scales = "free") +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = c("darkblue", "beige", "beige", "red"),
      values = scales::rescale(c(min(g1$Zscore), -0.65, 0, 8)),
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        ticks = FALSE, # Remove intermediate ticks
        draw.ulim = FALSE, # Remove top tick
        draw.llim = FALSE,
      ),
      breaks = c(-2, 8)
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0.2, 0, 1), "lines"),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 30)
    ) +
    labs(fill = "Z- scored FR")


  # activity across all units
  smo <- g1 %>%
    group_by(Behv, rel_time) %>%
    summarise(rate3 = mean(Zscore), sd = sd(Zscore), sem = sd / sqrt(n())) %>%
    ggplot(aes(rel_time, rate3)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = rate3 - sem, ymax = rate3 + sem), alpha = 0.4, fill = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, col = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_wrap(~Behv) +
    theme_smo +
    theme(
      plot.margin = unit(c(0.1, 0.2, 0, 1), "lines"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
    ) +
    xlab("time from stimulus") +
    ylab("Z-scored FR")

  # arrange plots
  plot <- ggpubr::ggarrange(map, smo,
    heights = c(2, 0.8), vjust = c(0.5, 0.5),
    ncol = 1, nrow = 2, align = "v", common.legend = T, legend = "right"
  )
  plot
}


plot_single_unit_se <- function(Combcont, cluster_id, smoothness = 0.1) {
  Datatemp <- Combcont %>%
    filter(cluster_id2 == !!cluster_id) %>%
    filter(event_count > 0, between(rel_time, -1, 1)) %>%
    group_by(Behv) %>%
    mutate(t2 = dense_rank(Trial))

  dots <- Combcont %>%
    filter(cluster_id2 == !!cluster_id) %>%
    filter(event_count > 0, between(rel_time, -1, 1)) %>%
    group_by(Behv) %>%
    mutate(t2 = dense_rank(Trial))

  avg <- Combcont %>%
    filter(
      cluster_id2 == !!cluster_id,
      between(rel_time, -1, 1)
    ) %>%
    mutate(rel_time = round(rel_time / smoothness) * smoothness) %>%
    group_by(Behv, Trial, rel_time) %>%
    summarise(
      count = sum(event_count),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # across trials
    group_by(Behv, rel_time) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_count = mean(count),
      sd_count = sd(count),
      n_trials = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      rate    = mean_count / smoothness,
      sd_rate = sd_count / smoothness,
      se      = sd_rate / sqrt(n_trials)
    )

  if (nrow(Datatemp) == 0) {
    stop("No data found for the specified cluster_id and filtering criteria.")
  }


  # Create the PSTH
  map <- dots %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_jitter(aes(rel_time, t2), height = 0.2, size = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~Behv, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0.2, 0, 1), "lines"),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 30),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = NULL, breaks = NULL) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = NULL) +
    labs(x = NULL) +
    ylab("Trials")

  # density plot
  smo <- avg %>%
    ggplot(aes(rel_time, rate)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = rate - se, ymax = rate + se), alpha = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~Behv) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = unit(c(0.1, 0.2, 0, 1), "lines"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank()
    ) +
    xlab("time from stimulus") +
    ylab("FR") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3))

  plot <- ggpubr::ggarrange(map, smo,
    heights = c(2, 0.8), vjust = c(0.5, 0.5),
    ncol = 1, nrow = 2, align = "v", common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right"
  )

  plot
}


add_layers <- function(Data, depthpath) {
  list_of_depth <- list.files(
    path = depthpath,
    pattern = "\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  depth <- read_csv(list_of_depth, id = "id", col_names = F)
  depth <- depth %>%
    mutate(id = str_extract(depth$id, "M\\d+_\\d+")) %>%
    rename("surface" = X1)


  Layerd <- Data %>%
    separate_wider_delim(cluster_id2, delim = "_", names = c("del", "Mouse", "Day"), cols_remove = F) %>%
    unite("id", c(Mouse, Day)) %>%
    select(!del) %>%
    left_join(depth) %>%
    replace_na(list(surface = 950)) %>% # for cambridge neurotech probes the distsance from pia was always 950
    mutate(dist_surf = surface - depth) %>%
    mutate(Layer_fine = case_when(
      between(dist_surf, -500, -20) ~ "out",
      between(dist_surf, -20, 50) ~ "L1",
      between(dist_surf, 50, 500) ~ "L2/3",
      between(dist_surf, 500, 750) ~ "L5A",
      between(dist_surf, 750, 1050) ~ "L5B",
      between(dist_surf, 1050, 1210) ~ "L6",
      .default = "WTF"
    )) %>%
    mutate(Layer = case_when(
      between(dist_surf, -500, -20) ~ "out",
      between(dist_surf, -20, 500) ~ "L2/3",
      between(dist_surf, 500, 1210) ~ "L5",
      .default = "WTF"
    ))
  Layerd
}
```

# C2
```{r}
# requires Trialless
# reload and reformat the meta_Data
metapath <- "F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/meta"
list_of_meta <- list.files(
  path = metapath,
  pattern = "\\.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

meta <- read_tsv(list_of_meta, id = "id2") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(id2, cluster_id, n_spikes, depth, group, fr)
meta <- meta %>% mutate(id = str_extract(meta$id2, "M\\d+_\\d+"))

# Peak_to_trough times from python script
list_of_ptt <- list.files(
  path = "F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/peak_to_trough_times",
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
ptt <- read_csv(list_of_ptt, id = "id2") %>% as_tibble()

# keys to match the names of the Neruopixels data to the shortfrom M{id}_{session}
translator <- read_csv2("F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/translator.csv")

# add meta infromation with PTT times
# add translator and use it to convert the ids
# filters PTT times that are smaller than 160 microseconds since these are liekly mistakes from the Spikeinterface algorithm  https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8491674/
# since ptt only included FS, all others will have NA, which we replace by the corresponding group from the manual curation ( inverted or regular)
PTT_data <- Trialless %>%
  left_join(meta %>% left_join(ptt %>% separate(Original_Index, into = c("old", "second_part"), sep = "(?=_row)", extra = "merge", remove = FALSE) %>%
    left_join(translator) %>% select(second_part:new) %>% select(!Folder) %>% separate_wider_delim(second_part, delim = "_", names = c("d1", "d2", "cluster_id")) %>% select(cluster_id:new) %>% rename(id = new) %>%
    mutate(cluster_id = as.numeric(cluster_id)) %>% filter(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` > 0.16)) %>%
    replace_na(list(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` = 0)) %>% mutate(newgroup = ifelse(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` == 0, group, "FS")) %>%
    filter(group != "noise")) %>%
  select(Behv:Zscore, newgroup, `Peak_to_Valley (ms)`) %>%
  filter(newgroup != "noise")




# Focus on important time
PTT_plot_data <- PTT_data %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, -0.1, 0.25)) %>%
  select(Behv, cluster_id2, Zscore, rel_time, newgroup)

# rename from Phy names to usefull names
PTT_plot_data <- PTT_plot_data %>% mutate(newgroup = case_when(
  newgroup == "FS" ~ "FS",
  newgroup == "good" ~ "regular",
  newgroup == "mua" ~ "inverted",
  .default = "WTF"
))

# plot mean + SEM
PTT_plot_data %>%
  group_by(Behv, rel_time, newgroup) %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  summarise(rate3 = mean(Zscore), sd = sd(Zscore), se = sd / sqrt(n())) %>%
  ggplot(aes(rel_time, rate3, col = newgroup, fill = newgroup)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = rate3 - se, ymax = rate3 + se), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, col = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.1, 0.2, 0, 0.7), "lines"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 30), axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  ) +
  xlab("time from stimulus") +
  ylab("Z-scored FR") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.07)
```

# D
```{r}
# baseline correction, does almost nothing
PTT_data <- PTT_data %>%
  left_join(PTT_data %>% filter(rel_time < 0) %>% group_by(Behv, newgroup) %>% summarise(bl = mean(Zscore))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Zscore = Zscore - bl)

# since there is a lot of jitter in when units fire but we are interested in the systems response to a stimulus i pick the moment that a unit has its highest FR in a narrow window after the Airpuff. Taking the Mean of the same time window reduced FR since they might only react strongly in 1 out of 4 10ms bins. The overall trends in the data remain the same but using this approach the values are also closer to the ones seen in the Data plots


PTT_stat_org <- PTT_data %>%
  distinct(newgroup, rel_time, Behv, Zscore, cluster_id2, id) %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, 0, 0.04)) %>%
  group_by(newgroup, cluster_id2, Behv) %>%
  slice_max(Zscore) %>%
  distinct(newgroup, Behv, cluster_id2, id, Zscore) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(id, names = c("Mouse", "Session"), delim = "_") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  na.omit()

# needed to backtransfrom to original scale
PPT_min <- min(PTT_stat_org$Zscore)

# transform to fit GAMMA and convert to factor
PTT_stat <- PTT_stat_org %>%
  mutate(Zscore = Zscore - min(Zscore) + 1) %>%
  mutate(across(c(newgroup, Behv, Mouse, Session), as.factor))

# full model
PPT_mod <- glmer(data = PTT_stat, Zscore ~ Behv + newgroup + Behv * newgroup + (1 | Mouse) + (1 | Mouse:Session), family = Gamma(link = "inverse"))
# null-model with same random components
PPT_NULL <- glmer(data = PTT_stat, Zscore ~ 1 + (1 | Mouse) + (1 | Mouse:Session), family = Gamma(link = "inverse"))

# compare to NULL model to see if it offers any increase in likelihood
anova(PPT_mod, PPT_NULL)

# simulate residuals and comapre to actual residuals, GOdness of Fit estimation
res <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = PPT_mod, plot = F, refit = F, use.u = T)
plotQQunif(res, testUniformity = F, testOutliers = F, testDispersion = F)







#  get esimates in response scale
emmeans_Behv_simp <- emmeans(PPT_mod, ~ newgroup | Behv, type = "response", adjust = "Tukey")
# get Pvalues for contrasts, Tukey p-val adjust
behvcon_simp <- emmeans(PPT_mod, pairwise ~ newgroup | Behv, adjust = "Tukey")

emm <- emmeans(PPT_mod, ~ newgroup | Behv)

pairs_res <- pairs(emm, adjust = "none")
p_vals_waveform <- as_tibble(summary(pairs_res, infer = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = round(p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),4))

# Convert to tibbles Filter for A2L

pdata <- emmeans_Behv_simp %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(newgroup = as.character(newgroup)) %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L")
pdata <- pdata %>% mutate(newgroup = trimws(as.character(newgroup)))

# Prepare p-values
pvals <- behvcon_simp$contrasts %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  separate_wider_delim(contrast, names = c("group1", "group2"), delim = "-") %>%
  mutate(psig = case_when(
    p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p.value > 0.05 ~ "NS",
  )) %>%
  mutate(group1 = as.character(group1), group2 = as.character(group2)) %>%
  mutate(group1 = trimws(group1), group2 = trimws(group2)) %>% # Ensure character type
  left_join(pdata %>% mutate(newgroup = as.character(newgroup)),
    by = join_by(group1 == newgroup)
  )

# Plot
ggplot(pdata %>% mutate(response = response + PPT_min - 1, asymp.LCL = asymp.LCL + PPT_min - 1, asymp.UCL = asymp.UCL + PPT_min - 1) %>% mutate(newgroup = case_when(
  newgroup == "FS" ~ "FS",
  newgroup == "good" ~ "RS",
  newgroup == "mua" ~ "inverted",
  .default = "Fuck"
)) %>% mutate(newgroup = factor(newgroup, levels = c("FS", "inverted", "RS"))), aes(x = newgroup, y = response)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), width = 0.2, linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(response, 2)), hjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylab("max Zscore response") +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    pvals %>% mutate(response = response + PPT_min - 1, asymp.LCL = asymp.LCL + PPT_min - 1, asymp.UCL = asymp.UCL + PPT_min - 1) %>% mutate(group1 = case_when(
      group1 == "FS" ~ "FS",
      group1 == "good" ~ "RS",
      group1 == "mua" ~ "inverted",
      .default = "WTF"
    )) %>% mutate(group2 = case_when(
      group2 == "FS" ~ "FS",
      group2 == "good" ~ "RS",
      group2 == "mua" ~ "inverted",
      .default = "WTF"
    )) %>% mutate(y.position = asymp.UCL + 0.3, y.position = ifelse(group1 == "FS" & group2 == "inverted", y.position + 0.4, y.position)),
    label = "psig",
    xmin = "group1", xmax = "group2", y.position = "y.position", size = 8, bracket.size = 1
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.3)
ggsave("E:/Berlin/figures_v2/Final/Raw_plots_v2/Into_fig/D.svg")



```

# E
```{r}
Layerd <- add_layers(Trialless, "F:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/depths")

# baseline correction
Layerd <- Layerd %>%
  left_join(Layerd %>% filter(rel_time < 0) %>% group_by(Behv, Layer) %>% summarise(bl = mean(Zscore))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Zscore = Zscore - bl)

# for backtransforming later
Layerd_stats_org <- Layerd %>%
  distinct(Layer, rel_time, Behv, Zscore, cluster_id2, id) %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, 0, 0.04)) %>%
  filter(Layer %in% c("L2/3", "L5")) %>%
  group_by(Layer, cluster_id2, Behv) %>%
  slice_max(Zscore) %>%
  distinct(Layer, Behv, cluster_id2, id, Zscore) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(id, names = c("Mouse", "Session"), delim = "_") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  na.omit()

Layerd_min <- min(Layerd_stats_org$Zscore)


# make all values positive to use Gamma distribution
Layerd_stats <- Layerd_stats_org %>%
  mutate(Zscore = Zscore - min(Zscore) + 1) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Layer, Behv, Mouse, Session), as.factor))


# fit and test the model

Layerd_mod <- glmer(data = Layerd_stats, Zscore ~ Behv + Layer + (1 | Mouse) + (1 | Mouse:Session), family = Gamma(link = "log"))
Layerd_Null <- glmer(data = Layerd_stats, Zscore ~ 1 + (1 | Mouse) + (1 | Mouse:Session), family = Gamma(link = "inverse"))
anova(Layerd_mod, Layerd_Null)

# Layerd_mod <- glmer(data = Layerd_stats, Zscore ~ Behv + Layer + (1 | Mouse) + (1 | Mouse:Session), family = Gamma(link = "inverse"))
# emmeans(Layerd_mod, ~ Layer | Behv, type = "response")


Layerd_mod <- glmer(data = Layerd_stats, Zscore ~ Behv + Layer + Behv:Layer + (1 | Mouse) + (1 | Mouse:Session), family = Gamma(link = "inverse"))
emmeans(Layerd_mod, ~ Layer | Behv, type = "response")


# check residuals
res <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(fittedModel = Layerd_mod, plot = F, refit = F, use.u = T)
DHARMa::plotQQunif(res, testUniformity = F, testOutliers = F, testDispersion = F)

# get estimates for the differences between Layers based on the Task and backtransform them from Link to the response scale
# estimates are L2/3 - 5
Layerd_EMM <- pairs(regrid(emmeans(Layerd_mod, ~ Layer | Behv, type = "response"),adjust='Tukey'))


final_p_values <- as_tibble(summary(Layerd_EMM, infer = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))

# get CIs and invert numbers to get the L5-L2/3 contrasts because the plot looks better
Layerd_EMM_CI <- summary(Layerd_EMM, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(contrast, Behv, estimate, asymp.LCL, asymp.UCL, p.value) %>%
  mutate(across(estimate:asymp.UCL, ~ . * -1))
Layerd_EMM_CI %>% ggplot(aes(Behv, estimate)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(estimate, 2)), hjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1.5)

# ggsave("E:/Berlin/figures_v2/Final/Raw_plots_v2/Into_fig/E.svg")
```

```{r}
ptt <- read_csv(list_of_ptt, id = "id2") %>% as_tibble()

# keys to match the names of the Neruopixels data to the shortfrom M{id}_{session}
translator <- read_csv2("E:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/translator.csv")

# add meta infromation with PTT times
# add translator and use it to convert the ids
# filters PTT times that are smaller than 160 microseconds since these are liekly mistakes from the Spikeinterface algorithm  https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8491674/
# since ptt only included FS, all others will have NA, which we replace by the corresponding group from the manual curation ( inverted or regular)

ptt2 <- ptt %>%
  separate(Original_Index, into = c("old", "second_part"), sep = "(?=_unit)", extra = "merge", remove = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(translator) %>%
  select(second_part:new) %>%
  select(!Folder) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(second_part, delim = "_", names = c("d1", "d2", "si_unit_id")) %>%
  select(si_unit_id:new) %>%
  rename(id = new) %>%
  mutate(si_unit_id = as.numeric(si_unit_id)) %>%
  filter(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` > 0.16) %>%
  unite("sid", c(si_unit_id, id), remove = F)

meta2 <- meta %>%
  unite("sid", c(si_unit_id, id), remove = F) %>%
  unite("cluster_id2", c(cluster_id, id), remove = F) %>%
  left_join(ptt2, by = join_by(sid)) %>%
  replace_na(list(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` = 0)) %>%
  mutate(newgroup = ifelse(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` == 0, group, "FS")) %>%
  filter(group != "noise")

PTT_data <- Trialless %>%
  left_join(meta2) %>%
  select(Behv:Zscore, newgroup, `Peak_to_Valley (ms)`) %>%
  filter(newgroup != "noise")




# Focus on important time
PTT_plot_data <- PTT_data %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, -0.1, 0.25)) %>%
  select(Behv, cluster_id2, Zscore, rel_time, newgroup)

# rename from Phy names to usefull names
PTT_plot_data <- PTT_plot_data %>% mutate(newgroup = case_when(
  newgroup == "FS" ~ "FS",
  newgroup == "good" ~ "regular",
  newgroup == "mua" ~ "inverted",
  .default = "WTF"
))

# plot mean + SEM
PTT_plot_data %>%
  group_by(Behv, rel_time, newgroup) %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  summarise(rate3 = mean(Zscore), sd = sd(Zscore), se = sd / sqrt(n())) %>%
  ggplot(aes(rel_time, rate3, col = newgroup, fill = newgroup)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = rate3 - se, ymax = rate3 + se), alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, col = "darkgrey", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.1, 0.2, 0, 0.7), "lines"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 30)
  ) +
  xlab("time from stimulus") +
  ylab("Z-scored FR") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.07)
```
